4,523 likes, 625 comments - halfbakedharvest on October 28, 2026: "Salted Sage Honey Butter Brioche Rolls - Comment HBH for the recipe! I’ll DM you direct! 

Ending October with Thanksgiving  planning in GO mode. I love this time of year! 

These are extra fluffy, buttery and perfectly salted with sweet sage honey butter swirled throughout each roll. Honestly, there isn’t a better roll. And they’re EASY. Very yummy for Thanksgiving too. Serve with extra honey butter!

https://www.halfbakedharvest.com/honey-butter-brioche-rolls/".
